//go:build linux && proxy_exit_kernel_test

package mynet

import (
	"bufio"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"github.com/godbus/dbus/v5"
	"github.com/mynet-club/mynet_agent/shared"
	"github.com/mynet-club/mynet_agent/shared/domain"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

// 仅由隔离容器脚本显式装入并执行，不把宿主机单测冒充内核验收。
func TestProxyExitKernel(t *testing.T) {
	run := func(argv []string, input string) (string, error) { return runProxyFirewall(false, argv, input) }
	must := func(argv ...string) string {
		out, err := run(argv, "")
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%v: %v", argv, err)
		}
		return out
	}
	dev := "gnb_tun"
	name := proxyExitName(dev)
	must("ip", "link", "add", dev, "type", "dummy")
	t.Run("nft", func(t *testing.T) {
		snap := &shared.SystemSnapshot{OS: "linux", Detail: map[string]json.RawMessage{"routing": json.RawMessage(`{"default_iface":"eth0"}`)}, Capabilities: map[string]bool{"nft": true}}
		if _, err := run([]string{"nft", "-f", "-"}, `add table ip nat
add chain ip nat POSTROUTING { type nat hook postrouting priority 100; }
add rule ip nat POSTROUTING iifname "wg_other" masquerade comment "sentinel"
add rule ip nat POSTROUTING iifname "gnb_tun" masquerade
add table ip filter
add chain ip filter FORWARD { type filter hook forward priority 0; }
add rule ip filter FORWARD iifname "gnb_tun" ip saddr 10.30.0.3/32 accept
add rule ip filter FORWARD iifname "gnb_tun" drop
`); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := syncProxyExitFirewall(snap, exitTestPolicy("10.30.0.3/32"), dev, true, run); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		before := must("nft", "list", "table", "inet", name)
		if strings.Contains(must("nft", "list", "table", "ip", "nat"), `iifname "gnb_tun"`) {
			t.Fatal("旧 NAT 未清")
		}
		if strings.Contains(must("nft", "list", "table", "ip", "filter"), `iifname "gnb_tun"`) {
			t.Fatal("旧 ACL 未清")
		}
		if !strings.Contains(before, "drop") {
			t.Fatal("兜底 DROP 缺失")
		}
		if err := syncProxyExitFirewall(snap, exitTestPolicy("10.30.0.4/32"), dev, false, run); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		after := must("nft", "list", "table", "inet", name)
		if strings.Contains(after, "10.30.0.3") || !strings.Contains(after, "10.30.0.4") {
			t.Fatal("旧白名单仍在")
		}
		if err := syncProxyExitFirewall(snap, exitTestPolicy("10.30.0.4/32"), dev, false, run); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if must("nft", "list", "table", "inet", name) != after {
			t.Fatal("重复安装有重复规则")
		}
		// 向真实 batch 注入非法命令，验证内核原子性，而不是 fake 的假设。
		bad := func(argv []string, input string) (string, error) {
			if input != "" {
				input += "invalid_nft_command\n"
			}
			return run(argv, input)
		}
		if err := syncProxyExitFirewall(snap, exitTestPolicy("10.30.0.5/32"), dev, false, bad); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("非法 batch 被接受")
		}
		if must("nft", "list", "table", "inet", name) != after {
			t.Fatal("内核没保留上一代")
		}
		if err := syncProxyExitFirewall(snap, nil, dev, true, run); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		revoked := must("nft", "list", "table", "inet", name)
		if !strings.Contains(revoked, `oifname "eth0" drop`) || strings.Contains(revoked, "masquerade") {
			t.Fatal("revocation lost deny guard")
		}
		if !strings.Contains(must("nft", "list", "table", "ip", "nat"), "sentinel") {
			t.Fatal("误删无关 NAT")
		}
		if err := syncProxyExitFirewall(snap, nil, dev, false, run); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		// 只删除本测试在隔离 namespace 创建的哨兵表，避免 nft 原生表干扰 iptables-nft 子用例。
		must("nft", "delete", "table", "ip", "nat")
		must("nft", "delete", "table", "ip", "filter")
	})
	t.Run("iptables", func(t *testing.T) {
		snap := &shared.SystemSnapshot{OS: "linux", Detail: map[string]json.RawMessage{"routing": json.RawMessage(`{"default_iface":"eth0"}`)}, Capabilities: map[string]bool{"iptables": true}}
		must("iptables", "-A", "FORWARD", "-i", "wg_other", "-m", "comment", "--comment", "sentinel", "-j", "ACCEPT")
		must("iptables", "-A", "FORWARD", "-i", dev, "-s", "10.30.0.3/32", "-j", "ACCEPT")
		must("iptables", "-A", "FORWARD", "-i", dev, "-j", "DROP")
		if err := syncProxyExitFirewall(snap, exitTestPolicy("10.30.0.3/32"), dev, true, run); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := syncProxyExitFirewall(snap, exitTestPolicy("10.30.0.4/32"), dev, false, run); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		before := must("iptables", "-t", "filter", "-S")
		if err := syncProxyExitFirewall(snap, exitTestPolicy("10.30.0.4/32"), dev, false, run); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if must("iptables", "-t", "filter", "-S") != before {
			t.Fatal("重复安装有重复规则")
		}
		failed := false
		bad := func(argv []string, input string) (string, error) {
			if !failed && strings.HasPrefix(input, "*mangle") {
				failed = true
				return "injected failure", errors.New("mangle failed")
			}
			return run(argv, input)
		}
		if err := syncProxyExitFirewall(snap, exitTestPolicy("10.30.0.5/32"), dev, false, bad); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("失败没报错")
		}
		if must("iptables", "-t", "filter", "-S") != before {
			t.Fatal("iptables 没恢复上一代")
		}
		if err := syncProxyExitFirewall(snap, nil, dev, true, run); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		for _, table := range []string{"mangle", "nat"} {
			if strings.Contains(must("iptables", "-t", table, "-S"), name) {
				t.Fatal("撤销残留：" + table)
			}
		}
		if !strings.Contains(must("iptables", "-t", "filter", "-S", name), "-j DROP") {
			t.Fatal("revocation lost WAN deny")
		}
		if !strings.Contains(must("iptables", "-t", "filter", "-S"), "sentinel") {
			t.Fatal("误删其他规则")
		}
		if err := syncProxyExitFirewall(snap, nil, dev, false, run); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	})
}

// Actual packets cross a tunnel veth and distinct LAN/WAN veths. Broad platform
// ACCEPT/NAT deliberately remain installed: only the MyNet WAN guard may deny.
func TestProxyExitWANFlowKernel(t *testing.T) {
	run := func(argv []string, input string) (string, error) { return runProxyFirewall(false, argv, input) }
	must := func(args ...string) string {
		out, err := run(args, "")
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%v: %v", args, err)
		}
		return out
	}
	must("sysctl", "-w", "net.ipv4.ip_forward=1")
	for _, link := range []struct{ dev, ns, host, peer string }{
		{"cpi_tun", "cpi-peer", "10.30.0.1/24", "10.30.0.3/24"},
		{"cpi_wan", "cpi-wan", "198.18.0.1/24", "198.18.0.2/24"},
		{"cpi_lan", "cpi-lan", "192.0.2.1/24", "192.0.2.2/24"},
	} {
		must("ip", "netns", "add", link.ns)
		must("ip", "link", "add", link.dev, "type", "veth", "peer", "name", "remote0")
		must("ip", "link", "set", "remote0", "netns", link.ns)
		must("ip", "addr", "add", link.host, "dev", link.dev)
		must("ip", "link", "set", link.dev, "up")
		must("ip", "netns", "exec", link.ns, "ip", "addr", "add", link.peer, "dev", "remote0")
		must("ip", "netns", "exec", link.ns, "ip", "link", "set", "remote0", "up")
		must("ip", "netns", "exec", link.ns, "ip", "link", "set", "lo", "up")
		must("ip", "netns", "exec", link.ns, "ip", "route", "add", "default", "via", strings.Split(link.host, "/")[0])
	}
	must("ip", "netns", "exec", "cpi-peer", "ip", "addr", "add", "10.30.0.4/24", "dev", "remote0")
	must("ip", "netns", "exec", "cpi-wan", "ip", "addr", "add", "203.0.113.2/32", "dev", "lo")
	must("ip", "route", "add", "203.0.113.2/32", "via", "198.18.0.2", "dev", "cpi_wan")

	plumbing := `add table ip cpi_platform
add chain ip cpi_platform forward { type filter hook forward priority 0; policy accept; }
add rule ip cpi_platform forward ct state established,related accept
add rule ip cpi_platform forward iifname "cpi_tun" accept
add chain ip cpi_platform postrouting { type nat hook postrouting priority 100; }
add rule ip cpi_platform postrouting iifname "cpi_tun" masquerade
`
	if _, err := run([]string{"nft", "-f", "-"}, plumbing); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	ping := func(dst, src string, want bool) {
		_, err := run([]string{"ip", "netns", "exec", "cpi-peer", "ping", "-c", "1", "-W", "1", "-I", src, dst}, "")
		if (err == nil) != want {
			t.Fatalf("ping %s -> %s success=%v want=%v", src, dst, err == nil, want)
		}
	}
	for _, backend := range []string{"nft", "iptables"} {
		t.Run(backend, func(t *testing.T) {
			snap := &shared.SystemSnapshot{OS: "linux", Capabilities: map[string]bool{backend: true}, Detail: map[string]json.RawMessage{"routing": json.RawMessage(`{"default_iface":"cpi_wan","routes":[{"destination":"198.18.0.0/24","interface":"cpi_wan","scope":"link"} ]}`)}}
			apply := func(p *domain.ProxyPolicy) {
				if err := syncProxyExitFirewall(snap, p, "cpi_tun", false, run); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
			}
			apply(nil)
			ping("203.0.113.2", "10.30.0.3", false)
			ping("192.0.2.2", "10.30.0.3", true)
			open := exitTestPolicy()
			open.ACL.Mode = domain.ProxyACLOpen
			apply(open)
			ping("203.0.113.2", "10.30.0.3", true)
			apply(exitTestPolicy("10.30.0.3/32"))
			ping("203.0.113.2", "10.30.0.3", true)
			ping("203.0.113.2", "10.30.0.4", false)
			ping("192.0.2.2", "10.30.0.4", true)
			ping("198.18.0.2", "10.30.0.4", true) // LAN on the default-route interface (bypass router)
			apply(nil)
			ping("203.0.113.2", "10.30.0.3", false)
			ping("192.0.2.2", "10.30.0.3", true)
			if backend == "nft" {
				home := t.TempDir()
				if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(home, "scripts"), 0755); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if err := writeFirewallArtifact(FirewallNftPath(home), []byte(plumbing), 0600); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if err := writeProxyExitReplayArtifact(home, "cpi_tun", proxyExitScope{WAN: []string{"cpi_wan"}, LAN: []string{"198.18.0.0/24"}}, nil); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				body, err := firewallIncludeScript("cpi_tun", "cpi_wan")
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if err := os.WriteFile(FirewallIncludePath(home), []byte(body), 0755); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				must("nft", "flush", "ruleset")
				must("sh", FirewallIncludePath(home))
				ping("203.0.113.2", "10.30.0.3", false)
				ping("192.0.2.2", "10.30.0.3", true)
				must("nft", "delete", "table", "inet", proxyExitName("cpi_tun"))
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestFirewalldWatcherProcess(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("MYNET_EVENT_WATCH_CHILD") != "1" {
		t.Fatal("helper requires parent integration test")
	}
	if rc := cmdFirewallWatch(nil); rc != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("watch exited: %d", rc)
	}
}

func TestFirewalldReloadEventKernel(t *testing.T) {
	bus := exec.Command("dbus-daemon", "--session", "--nofork", "--print-address=1")
	stdout, err := bus.StdoutPipe()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := bus.Start(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer func() { _ = bus.Process.Kill(); _ = bus.Wait() }()
	reader := bufio.NewReader(stdout)
	address, err := reader.ReadString('\n')
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	conn, err := dbus.Connect(strings.TrimSpace(address))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer conn.Close()
	reply, err := conn.RequestName("org.fedoraproject.FirewallD1", dbus.NameFlagDoNotQueue)
	if err != nil || reply != dbus.RequestNameReplyPrimaryOwner {
		t.Fatalf("fake firewalld name: %v %v", reply, err)
	}
	home := t.TempDir()
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(home, "scripts"), 0755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	artifact := "add table ip mynet_event_probe\nadd chain ip mynet_event_probe probe\nflush chain ip mynet_event_probe probe\n"
	if err := os.WriteFile(FirewallNftPath(home), []byte(artifact), 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	binary, err := os.Executable()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	watcher := exec.Command(binary, "-test.run=^TestFirewalldWatcherProcess$")
	watcher.Env = append(os.Environ(), "MYNET_EVENT_WATCH_CHILD=1", "MYNET_HOME="+home, "DBUS_SYSTEM_BUS_ADDRESS="+strings.TrimSpace(address))
	if err := watcher.Start(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer func() { _ = watcher.Process.Kill(); _ = watcher.Wait() }()
	exists := func() bool {
		_, err := runProxyFirewall(false, []string{"nft", "list", "table", "ip", "mynet_event_probe"}, "")
		return err == nil
	}
	await := func() {
		t.Helper()
		until := time.Now().Add(3 * time.Second)
		for time.Now().Before(until) {
			if exists() {
				return
			}
			time.Sleep(20 * time.Millisecond)
		}
		t.Fatal("reload event did not restore nft artifact")
	}
	await() // initial subscription + replay has completed.
	if _, err := runProxyFirewall(false, []string{"nft", "delete", "table", "ip", "mynet_event_probe"}, ""); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := conn.Emit(dbus.ObjectPath("/org/fedoraproject/FirewallD1"), "org.fedoraproject.FirewallD1.Reloaded"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	await()
}
